demo.code:
You:   Open a 10 USDC Stonk Gacha pack
Bankr: You are short 8 USDC on Base. Stonk Gacha also needs separate native Base ETH for the exact Pyth fee. Eligible Base sources: 0.12 ETH or 1.0 WETH. Which source should I quote? I will not choose or lower the pack for you.
You:   Use WETH
Bankr: I bound Bankr's raw quoted output to the exact 8 USDC deficit and rejected excess sizing. Confirm this bounded sequence: spend at most the quoted WETH, include the shown exact-shortfall WETH-to-native top-up if needed, conditionally reset and approve exactly 10 USDC, then open pack 1 with the shown offer hash, ceiling, and native fee cap?
You:   Yes
Bankr: I will execute each confirmed step sequentially and recheck expiry, linked wallet, execution journal, request count, offer, fee, and native headroom before opening.

setup: Install the skill from its public GitHub repository URL
Use the active Bankr EVM wallet on Base; never paste or expose a private key
Keep Wallet API read-write access and arbitrary contract calls enabled for writes
Run the bundled live self-test once after install or update
Every protocol write is planned as one unsigned transaction and verified after its mined receipt
Funded quotes bind the response to.amount raw units to exact deficit or native-shortfall floors and reject oversized outputs
X approvals require trusted posted-text/channel metadata, replied_to parent binding, numeric identity, linked wallet, expiry, and atomic one-time consumption
